title: Duties
description: Every read-only duty check, what it says now, who it routes to and its last results.
why: The duty checks are how the company finds its own work without paying a model to look; the owner should see at a glance which ones are due, broken or have stopped running.

actions.label: Ask what is being done
actions.text: Please tell me in plain words which duty checks on {{panel.title}} are due, broken or stale, and who is on each.
